token_near_graduation.meaning: LaunchToken is near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY (its graduation point)

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the (token,quote) UniSwapV2 pair exists, deployed by the attacker, before graduation

attacker_quote_supplied_wei.meaning: amount of quote the attacker supplies to a newly created token's pair

mass_attack_occurs.meaning: the massive attack manifests when the token reaches BONDING_SUPPLY as a result of the attacker's 1 wei quote supply

graduation_completes.meaning: graduation completes: 20% of token and all held quoteReserve deposited into the UniSwapV2 pool without reverting

assumptions: The attacker needs no special authorization beyond supplying 1 wei of quote to the newly created pair.
The pair is attacker-deployed before graduation; exact creation cost is unspecified.
The 'massive attack' is a potential consequence stated by the report, not an observed incident.

unresolved.description: Report does not define the exact numeric threshold for 'near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY' nor the precise mechanism by which 1 wei of quote per token produces the massive attack; the impact is stated only qualitatively.

limitations: The impact is formalized as a qualitative occurrence Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition of the 'massive attack' magnitude.
The 20% token / all quoteReserve deposit amounts are not bound as separate symbols; graduation completion is represented as a single observable outcome.
Only the mass_attack_one_wei_each impact is formalized; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
